CustomField.description: At Risk when an open opportunity has been open longer than HES Setting > At Risk Days (SAL-04); otherwise Healthy.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(IsClosed), TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > $CustomMetadata.HES_Setting__mdt.Default.At_Risk_Days__c ), "At Risk", "Healthy" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Based on how many days the deal has been open. At Risk deals need attention in the weekly review.
CustomField.label: Deal Health
